I can create this — quick confirmations before I add it to your calendar:

1) Organizer account: should I create it on your calendar? If so, which email (or say “use my default”)?
2) Date/time/time zone: Thu, Oct 9, 2:00–3:00 PM Central Time (US Central — America/Chicago). Confirm?
3) Attendees & emails: Rosa Lindqvist — email? Hana Okafor — email? (I need their addresses to send invites.)
4) Video bridge: add a conference link? If yes, which provider (Google Meet / Zoom / Teams / other) or “any”?
5) Invitations: send invites to attendees now, or just add to your calendar without sending?
6) Event description / agenda (optional): anything to include in the invite?

Reply with confirmations and the attendees’ email addresses (and your organizer email if not your default). I’ll create the one-off event once you confirm.
